79003.hook: A sweeping myth of humanity's rise and fall imagines two billion years of future evolution.

79004.hook: Two brothers set off into unmapped West Africa chasing the fate of a vanished explorer.

79005.hook: A hilltop household stirs at dawn as mists and a growing shadow settle over young Madge's fragile world.

79006.hook: Petty jealousies and quiet cruelties simmer among English guests at a sun-drenched Italian hotel.

79007.hook: The Founding Fathers sign the Declaration of Independence like a crew of wisecracking gangsters on the job.

79008.hook: A desk-bound executive must secretly learn to fly a Fly-Wheel before a rival exposes his humiliating lie.
